name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at Seoul National University, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion that would define his career. He quickly rose through the ranks, showcasing a natural talent for problem-solving and a keen eye for detail. Before joining Iron Dames, Park spent several years honing his skills with smaller teams, developing a reputation for resourcefulness and an ability to extract maximum performance from limited budgets.

As a chief engineer, Park is known for his methodical approach to race preparation and his calm demeanor under pressure. He emphasizes data analysis and collaboration, fostering a team environment where every member feels empowered to contribute. While not the most flamboyant innovator, Park's strength lies in his ability to implement proven technologies and optimize existing systems for peak efficiency. He values reliability and consistency, believing that these are the keys to long-term success in the demanding world of motorsport.
